questions.stem: A 24-Year-old woman with nine weeks of amenorrhea presents with a history of severe abdomen pain and bleeding pv for one day. She has no comorbidities. She is on progesterone-only pill contraception. No history of comorbidities. On examination, P-110/min, BP-114/76mmHg, temperature 99F, saturation normal, RR-14/min, pallor present. Abdominal examination shows tenderness. PV examination shows a bleed; no other findings are present. USG was advised and showed a ruptured tubal ectopic. Beta hCG levels were analyzed?

options.label: B
options.text: Manage this condition Follow up with beta hCG
